title: Lane D-1 — MEMORY_ROUTER Contract Freeze (interface-only, zero business logic)
context: Lane D-1 is the signature-level freeze of the MEMORY_ROUTER routing layer that sits between parallax.retrieval.Intent (semantic intent, ADR-006) and parallax.server.routes.query.RetrieveKind (HTTP dispatch). Both existing enums stay untouched. This PRD delivers: (a) QueryType — a new 5-value closed-set enum; (b) 4 capability ports as typed Protocols (Query / Ingest / Inspect / Backfill); (c) request/response dataclasses; (d) ArbitrationDecision canonical type; (e) Crosswalk seed mapping table (read-only, from Intent|RetrieveKind -> QueryType); (f) MockMemoryRouter that raises NotImplementedError on every port method; (g) MEMORY_ROUTER flag plumbing, default false; (h) contract-test skeleton gated by xfail so main stays green. Former draft name 'Lane C'; renamed to avoid collision with Lane C Phase 1 (MEMORY.md interception hook in commit 629df02). Explicit non-goals: no business logic, no real adapter, no backfill dry-run runner, no field normalization (memory.body / claim.object_ / event.payload_text unification is deliberately deferred to Lane D-2 as known tech debt, see Sonnet Critic warning in xcouncil Round 2). Rules: TDD RED->xfail->GREEN (skeleton RED is allowed via xfail only; no bare failing tests in main), immutability (frozen dataclasses + tuple containers), KISS/DRY/YAGNI, type hints on every signature, ruff clean, coverage floor 80% preserved. Reviewer: critic (Opus). Rollback: if contract tests drop below 100% on the feature branch, git revert the PR; MEMORY_ROUTER flag remains false. SLA: 30 min to flag-off / revert action, 60-120 min to fully verify (518 baseline tests green + staging no writes + mapping table untouched). Naming (SWAP POINT — Chris can override in one line): QueryType values use Codex-派 (RECENT_CONTEXT / ARTIFACT_CONTEXT / ENTITY_PROFILE / CHANGE_TRACE / TEMPORAL_CONTEXT) because (1) they don't collide with Intent or RetrieveKind — the third-layer abstraction stays abstract, (2) CHANGE_TRACE legitimately covers decision+bug since LongMemEval never exercises by_bug_fix (grep eval/ returns zero). Intent.FALLBACK policy (SWAP POINT — Chris can override): raise UnroutableQueryError on Crosswalk lookup, never silently map to a sentinel, per GPT-OSS recommendation and the project rule 'never silently swallow errors'.

stories.title: QueryType enum — 5-value closed set, signature-level frozen
acceptanceCriteria: New file parallax/router/types.py exists. It MUST be importable without importing parallax.retrieval or parallax.server (the router package is the new third layer and must not depend on either enum's module).

types.py defines exactly one enum named QueryType inheriting from (str, Enum). Exactly 5 members, in this order, with these name/value pairs: RECENT_CONTEXT='recent_context', ARTIFACT_CONTEXT='artifact_context', ENTITY_PROFILE='entity_profile', CHANGE_TRACE='change_trace', TEMPORAL_CONTEXT='temporal_context'. SWAP POINT: if Chris names differently, substitute across this entire PRD.

Each member has a one-line docstring-style comment on its own line directly above the assignment, stating the semantic. REQUIRED text (exact, including the Chinese/English mix): RECENT_CONTEXT = near-term conversation + multi-session continuity; ARTIFACT_CONTEXT = file / path / artifact memory; ENTITY_PROFILE = entity profile (user_fact / preference / named entity); CHANGE_TRACE = decisions + bug fixes (change history); TEMPORAL_CONTEXT = when / before / after time-window queries.
types.py ALSO defines MappingState as (str, Enum) with exactly three values: MAPPED='mapped', UNMAPPED='unmapped', CONFLICT='conflict'. Order fixed in that sequence.

types.py ALSO defines one frozen dataclass FieldCandidate with fields (in order): source: str, field_name: str, value: Any, confidence: float. FieldCandidate is fully defined here; ArbitrationDecision (which consumes it) lives in contracts.py and imports FieldCandidate from types.py. The public __all__ of types.py must list exactly: ['QueryType', 'MappingState', 'FieldCandidate'].
New file tests/router/__init__.py exists (empty) so pytest collects the new test module regardless of rootdir-relative resolution.
parallax/__init__.py is NOT modified — router is opt-in via explicit `from parallax.router.types import QueryType` imports.
PRESERVE: parallax/retrieval/contracts.py Intent enum has zero diff.
PRESERVE: parallax/server/routes/query.py RetrieveKind literal and _dispatch function have zero diff.

New test tests/router/test_query_type.py asserts: len(list(QueryType)) == 5; list of values is exactly ['recent_context','artifact_context','entity_profile','change_trace','temporal_context']; QueryType('recent_context') is QueryType.RECENT_CONTEXT (value round-trip); QueryType.RECENT_CONTEXT.name == 'RECENT_CONTEXT'; isinstance(QueryType.RECENT_CONTEXT, str) is True.
New test tests/router/test_query_type.py asserts len(list(MappingState)) == 3 and its values are exactly ['mapped','unmapped','conflict'].

Subprocess import discipline test in tests/router/test_query_type.py: `python -c 'import parallax.router.types; import sys; assert "parallax.retrieval" not in sys.modules; assert "parallax.server" not in sys.modules'` exits 0. (Verifies the router package doesn't transitively drag in the other layers.)
`python -m pytest tests/router/test_query_type.py --no-cov -v` exits 0 with all assertions passing.
ruff check parallax/router/types.py tests/router/test_query_type.py returns 0 errors.

stories.title: Four capability ports as runtime_checkable Protocols (signature-level frozen)
acceptanceCriteria: New file parallax/router/ports.py exists. All four port classes use @runtime_checkable Protocol from typing. ports.py imports directly from parallax.router.contracts (QueryRequest, IngestRequest, IngestResult, BackfillRequest, BackfillReport, HealthReport, RetrievalEvidence) so annotations are real types, not string forward references. Dependency graph: types.py (no deps) ← contracts.py ← ports.py ← mock_adapter.py.
QueryPort.query exact signature: `def query(self, request: QueryRequest) -> RetrievalEvidence: ...`. Exactly one abstract method; no default implementation.
IngestPort.ingest exact signature: `def ingest(self, request: IngestRequest) -> IngestResult: ...`. Exactly one abstract method.
InspectPort.health exact signature: `def health(self) -> HealthReport: ...`. Exactly one abstract method, no arguments beyond self.
BackfillPort.backfill exact signature: `def backfill(self, request: BackfillRequest) -> BackfillReport: ...`. Exactly one abstract method.
ports.py public __all__ lists exactly: ['QueryPort', 'IngestPort', 'InspectPort', 'BackfillPort'].
ports.py does NOT define any concrete class; Protocols only.

Each port class has a one-sentence class-level docstring stating its capability boundary: QueryPort='Route a typed query request to evidence hits.' / IngestPort='Persist a memory / claim payload into the router store.' / InspectPort='Return the router's health and introspection snapshot.' / BackfillPort='Run a Crosswalk-driven backfill; MUST honour request.dry_run.'
New test tests/router/test_ports_protocol.py asserts: `isinstance(MockMemoryRouter(), QueryPort)` is True for all four ports (uses runtime_checkable). Test imports MockMemoryRouter from US-004.

Signature introspection test: for each port class and its single method, inspect.signature(...) yields parameter names exactly ['self', 'request'] for Query/Ingest/Backfill and ['self'] for Inspect; typing.get_type_hints(<method>) resolves to the concrete contract classes (not strings), proving direct imports succeeded and no cycles exist.
`python -m pytest tests/router/test_ports_protocol.py --no-cov -v` exits 0.
ruff check parallax/router/ports.py tests/router/test_ports_protocol.py returns 0 errors.

stories.title: Request / response contracts — frozen dataclasses with explicit field types
acceptanceCriteria: New file parallax/router/contracts.py exists and re-exports parallax.retrieval.contracts.RetrievalEvidence (NOT redefined — the router consumes the existing ADR-006 evidence type so downstream tooling keeps working).
QueryRequest(@dataclass(frozen=True)) fields in this order: query_type: QueryType; user_id: str; q: str = ''; limit: int = 10; since: str | None = None; until: str | None = None; level: int = 1.
IngestRequest(@dataclass(frozen=True)) fields: user_id: str; kind: Literal['memory', 'claim'] ; payload: dict[str, Any]; source_id: str | None = None.
IngestResult(@dataclass(frozen=True)) fields: kind: Literal['memory', 'claim']; identifier: str; deduped: bool.
BackfillRequest(@dataclass(frozen=True)) fields: user_id: str; crosswalk_version: str; dry_run: bool = True; scope: Literal['all', 'sample'] = 'sample'.

BackfillReport(@dataclass(frozen=True)) fields: rows_examined: int; rows_mapped: int; rows_unmapped: int; rows_conflict: int; writes_performed: int; arbitrations: tuple[ArbitrationDecision, ...]. INVARIANT (enforced in test, not __post_init__): `writes_performed == 0` when request.dry_run is True.
HealthReport(@dataclass(frozen=True)) fields: ok: bool; flag_enabled: bool; query_type_count: int; ports_registered: tuple[str, ...]; crosswalk_seed_hash: str.

ArbitrationDecision(@dataclass(frozen=True)) fields in this order: canonical_field: str; state: MappingState; selected: FieldCandidate | None; candidates: tuple[FieldCandidate, ...]; reason_code: str; reason: str; confidence: float; requires_manual_review: bool. MUST support to_json_line() -> str (json.dumps with MappingState.value and tuple->list coercion, deterministic key order via sort_keys=True).
contracts.py public __all__ lists exactly: ['QueryRequest','IngestRequest','IngestResult','BackfillRequest','BackfillReport','HealthReport','ArbitrationDecision','RetrievalEvidence'].
All dataclasses are @dataclass(frozen=True) and hashable (no mutable default values, lists replaced with tuples).

New test tests/router/test_contracts.py asserts for every dataclass: (a) frozen=True (attempt to set attribute raises FrozenInstanceError), (b) required fields match the list above by name+type (using dataclasses.fields), (c) BackfillReport.writes_performed==0 when dry_run round-tripped through a minimal invariant helper.

test_contracts.py asserts ArbitrationDecision.to_json_line() output is stable across two calls with identical inputs (no timestamps, no random ordering) and json.loads round-trips to a dict whose 'state' key equals the MappingState string value.
`python -m pytest tests/router/test_contracts.py --no-cov -v` exits 0.
ruff check parallax/router/contracts.py tests/router/test_contracts.py returns 0 errors.

stories.title: MockMemoryRouter (all four ports, NotImplementedError with clear messages) + Crosswalk seed mapping (read-only)
acceptanceCriteria: New file parallax/router/mock_adapter.py defines class MockMemoryRouter that implements all four Protocols structurally (no explicit inheritance — Protocols are duck-typed).
MockMemoryRouter.query(request) raises NotImplementedError('Lane D-1 freeze: MockMemoryRouter.query is intentionally unimplemented; real adapter lands in Lane D-2') verbatim.
MockMemoryRouter.ingest(request) raises NotImplementedError with message 'Lane D-1 freeze: MockMemoryRouter.ingest is intentionally unimplemented; real adapter lands in Lane D-2'.
MockMemoryRouter.backfill(request) raises NotImplementedError with message 'Lane D-1 freeze: MockMemoryRouter.backfill is intentionally unimplemented; real adapter lands in Lane D-2'.

MockMemoryRouter.health() returns a real HealthReport (NOT NotImplementedError) with: ok=True; flag_enabled=<read from parallax.router.config.MEMORY_ROUTER at call time>; query_type_count=5; ports_registered=('QueryPort','IngestPort','InspectPort','BackfillPort'); crosswalk_seed_hash=<sha256 hex digest of the seed mapping JSON, deterministic order>. Rationale: health is the one sanity probe that must work even in frozen mode so /inspect never returns 500.

New file parallax/router/crosswalk_seed.py defines CROSSWALK_SEED as a frozen types.MappingProxyType wrapping a plain dict. Keys are the string literals below; values are QueryType members. Exact entries (all must be present, no more, no less): 'Intent.TEMPORAL' -> QueryType.TEMPORAL_CONTEXT; 'Intent.MULTI_SESSION' -> QueryType.RECENT_CONTEXT; 'Intent.PREFERENCE' -> QueryType.ENTITY_PROFILE; 'Intent.USER_FACT' -> QueryType.ENTITY_PROFILE; 'Intent.KNOWLEDGE_UPDATE' -> QueryType.CHANGE_TRACE; 'RetrieveKind.recent' -> QueryType.RECENT_CONTEXT; 'RetrieveKind.file' -> QueryType.ARTIFACT_CONTEXT; 'RetrieveKind.decision' -> QueryType.CHANGE_TRACE; 'RetrieveKind.bug' -> QueryType.CHANGE_TRACE; 'RetrieveKind.entity' -> QueryType.ENTITY_PROFILE; 'RetrieveKind.timeline' -> QueryType.TEMPORAL_CONTEXT. NOTE: 'Intent.FALLBACK' is intentionally absent from this mapping.

crosswalk_seed.py also defines UnroutableQueryError(Exception) and a public helper resolve(legacy: str) -> QueryType that looks up CROSSWALK_SEED[legacy] and raises UnroutableQueryError(f'legacy key {legacy!r} is unmapped (likely Intent.FALLBACK)') when missing. Rationale: Intent.FALLBACK policy = raise, never silent map. SWAP POINT — Chris can override to return a sentinel.
crosswalk_seed.py __all__ lists exactly: ['CROSSWALK_SEED', 'resolve', 'UnroutableQueryError', 'seed_hash'].
seed_hash() -> str returns sha256 hex of json.dumps(dict(CROSSWALK_SEED) with QueryType coerced to .value, sorted keys, no whitespace). Same call returns the same string byte-for-byte.

New test tests/router/test_mock_and_seed.py asserts: each of query/ingest/backfill raises NotImplementedError and the message CONTAINS the substring 'Lane D-1 freeze'; health() returns a HealthReport with ok=True and ports_registered tuple exactly matching the four port names; MockMemoryRouter is structurally a QueryPort, IngestPort, InspectPort, BackfillPort via isinstance (proves runtime_checkable).

test_mock_and_seed.py asserts: resolve('Intent.TEMPORAL') is QueryType.TEMPORAL_CONTEXT; resolve('Intent.FALLBACK') raises UnroutableQueryError; resolve('RetrieveKind.bug') is QueryType.CHANGE_TRACE; len(CROSSWALK_SEED) == 11 (5 mapped Intents excluding FALLBACK, + 6 RetrieveKinds); seed_hash() returns the same value on two calls and len(seed_hash()) == 64.
`python -m pytest tests/router/test_mock_and_seed.py --no-cov -v` exits 0.
ruff check parallax/router/mock_adapter.py parallax/router/crosswalk_seed.py tests/router/test_mock_and_seed.py returns 0 errors.

stories.title: MEMORY_ROUTER flag wiring + contract-test skeleton gated by xfail + full-suite green
acceptanceCriteria: New file parallax/router/config.py exports MEMORY_ROUTER as a module-level Final[bool]. Default reads from os.getenv('MEMORY_ROUTER', 'false').strip().lower() == 'true'. Accepted truthy: only the literal 'true' (case-insensitive). Anything else -> False.

config.py ALSO exposes a helper `is_router_enabled() -> bool` that re-reads the env var at call time (for tests that want to mutate os.environ and observe change). The module-level Final captures the value at import time (production path); the helper is the dynamic path. Both must be exported.
config.py __all__ lists exactly: ['MEMORY_ROUTER', 'is_router_enabled'].

New file parallax/router/__init__.py re-exports: QueryType, MappingState, FieldCandidate, ArbitrationDecision, QueryRequest, IngestRequest, IngestResult, BackfillRequest, BackfillReport, HealthReport, RetrievalEvidence, QueryPort, IngestPort, InspectPort, BackfillPort, MockMemoryRouter, CROSSWALK_SEED, resolve, UnroutableQueryError, seed_hash, MEMORY_ROUTER, is_router_enabled. No other public names.
`python -c 'import parallax; from parallax.router import QueryType, MEMORY_ROUTER; assert MEMORY_ROUTER is False'` exits 0 in the default test env (no MEMORY_ROUTER var set).
`python -c 'import os; os.environ["MEMORY_ROUTER"]="true"; from parallax.router.config import is_router_enabled; assert is_router_enabled() is True'` exits 0.

New test tests/router/test_flag_wiring.py asserts: default MEMORY_ROUTER==False; truthy case-insensitive ('TRUE','True','true') via monkeypatch and is_router_enabled() returns True; every other string ('1','yes','on','') returns False; HealthReport from MockMemoryRouter().health() reflects the current flag value.

New test file tests/router/test_contract_skeleton.py contains one @pytest.mark.xfail(strict=True, reason='Lane D-1 freeze: real adapter arrives in Lane D-2; mock deliberately raises') test per port method (query, ingest, backfill) that instantiates MockMemoryRouter and calls the method with minimal valid kwargs. Each test MUST be strict xfail so if a future accidental implementation stops raising, the suite turns red.
test_contract_skeleton.py also contains ONE non-xfail test that calls MockMemoryRouter().health() and asserts ok==True, query_type_count==5, and ports_registered is the 4-tuple of port class names.
No test file in tests/router/ uses plain `pytest.fail` or bare `assert False` as a placeholder. Skeleton RED is xfail-only; main stays green.
Full suite: `cd E:/Parallax && python -m pytest tests/ -q` exits 0. Coverage gate (existing cov-fail-under 80) still passes. The xfail tests show as xfailed in the summary, not as failures.
ruff check parallax/router/ tests/router/ returns 0 errors.

parallax/server/routes/query.py, parallax/retrieval/contracts.py, parallax/retrieve.py all have zero diff at the end of this story (preservation check: `git diff --name-only origin/main -- parallax/retrieval/ parallax/server/ parallax/retrieve.py` lists zero files).
